dimensions.detail: The purpose, README, SKILL.md, and Python script align around fetching guitar chords and lyrics from mychords.net, amdm.ru, and ultimate-guitar.com, then cleaning the output.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill tells the agent to run an included Python script when the user asks for song chords; that invokes network search/fetching, but the behavior is directly related to the stated purpose and is described in the artifacts.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install hooks, binary downloads, obfuscation, or auto-start behavior were found. Dependencies are normal Python packages listed for parsing and DuckDuckGo search.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Outbound network access is required and song/artist queries are sent to DuckDuckGo and selected chord sites, but the skill does not request credentials, tokens, browser profiles, or broad local data.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The script runs on demand, prints results, and does not create persistence, background workers, privilege changes, or modifications to agent configuration.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: Network access is real, but it is purpose-aligned and disclosed in SKILL.md and README; the script also restricts fetched result hosts to the expected chord sites.
[SQP-1] expected: The trigger is scoped to user requests for song chords, matching the skill purpose; this is not high-impact access and does not show hidden or unrelated execution.
[SQP-2] expected: The artifacts do disclose DuckDuckGo and the target chord sites, so the data-flow concern is best treated as user guidance rather than a Review verdict.
[staticScan.clean] expected: Static scan reported no suspicious patterns, consistent with the inspected artifacts.
[VirusTotal.pending] expected: VirusTotal was pending and provides no artifact-backed negative signal.
llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with song and artist queries being sent to DuckDuckGo and public chord websites. Avoid putting private text into the song query, and use normal caution with Python package dependencies such as ddgs and beautifulsoup4.
llm.summary: This skill does what it claims: it searches public chord sites for a song and returns cleaned chord text, without hidden persistence, credential use, or unrelated access.
